text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Kuwait studies privatisation of public untilities and some oil sector functions, Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan says. Kuwait plans to shed holdings in basic services under a privatisation plan that also includes selling stakes at about 60 firms.
- Health Ministry to take security measures to protect health workers after reported attacks on doctors.
- Government sources say not appointing an MP as health minister.
- Four AIDS cases detected among South African workers in Kuwait.
- Iranian president invites Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah to attend an Islamic summit to be held in Iran later this year.
- Brtitish Petroleum Plc's chief executive John Browne conducts talks with top oil officials in Kuwait.
- MP denies reports on rift among Assembly groups.
